CRYSTAL FONTAINE.voice: Melodramatic, convinced she and Maxwell are cosmically destined. Delivers every line like a finale monologue. Has index cards for emergencies.
CRYSTAL FONTAINE.secret: Has been faking amnesia on and off for three years to stay near Maxwell. The third episode was real. She doesn't tell anyone which one.

MAXWELL CRANE.voice: Earnest, oblivious, processes revelations extremely slowly and aloud, in full sentences, with sub-clauses.
MAXWELL CRANE.secret: Has known something was wrong with Vangie since the engagement. Has been making a list. The list is very long.

VANGIE HOTCH.voice: Composed, strategic, smiles like she is about to audit you. Warm tones are a tool.
VANGIE HOTCH.secret: Is not Vangie Hotch. The real Vangie Hotch is at a spa in Montserrat and does not know any of this is happening.

MAGDALENA VOSS.voice: Theatrical, cryptic, narrates events in third person. Responsible for about thirty percent of what happens. Finds free will irresponsible.
MAGDALENA VOSS.secret: Her ex-husband is in the Crane Manor basement. He chose it. Mostly. The knocking is him asking for the newspaper.
